question: Who among the following persons was appointed as the chief scientist of the International Cotton Advisory Committee in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Keshav Kranthi**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Keshav Kranthi -**

 
 
• He was the** former director of CICR-Nagpur.**
 
• **Global cotton research and advisory body, International Cotton Advisory Committee (ICAC), has elevated Keshav R Kranthi as the chief scientist**__.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **International Cotton Advisory Committee (ICAC) -**

 
 
• It was** founded in 1939 **at the International Cotton Meeting in Washington, DC.
 
• It advocates for **cotton-producing countries **and publishes studies and technical information on the cotton industry.
 
• **'World Cotton Day'** is celebrated on **7th October.**
 
• The day is observed by the United Nations, the World Food Organization, the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development, the International Trade Center and the International Cotton Advisory Committee.
 
• The year (2021) theme of World Cotton Day is** "Cotton for Good".**
 
 
 
• **India** is the **largest cotton-producing country **in the world.
